Did you talk about something with the two 
of them?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing really? Nothing at all. Didn't we 
last grab a meal together the day before 
yesterday?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even then, we didn't talk about anything 
special.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like how Ticket's tests are a 
disaster, or how Hayahide is getting on 
Brian's nerves again, that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's fine by me. I'm not much 
of a talker to begin with.
